title: 铜灯下的凹龛

titles.en: The Recess Beneath the Bronze Lamp

text: 凹龛的铜灯早已熄灭。墙边散着工匠留下的磨料和小工具，底座后还压着几件金属旧物。要搬出后面的东西，得先清开碎石。

texts.en: The bronze lamp in the recess went out long ago. Abrasives and small tools left by some craftsman lie along the wall, and a few old metal pieces are wedged behind the base. Getting at those means clearing the rubble first.

options.label: 收起工匠材料（加工材料 ×{give_pool_item_count}）

outcomes.text: 你抹去细灰，收起{reward_name}，它还能用在下一次加工上。

texts.en: You wipe off the fine dust and keep the {reward_name}. It'll still serve for the next job.

options.label: 清开底座（倒计时 −{pass_time_actions}，金属旧物 ×{give_pool_item_count}）

outcomes.text: 你清开碎石，把{reward_name}放到脚边，余物滑入了更深的缝隙。

texts.en: You clear the rubble and set the {reward_name} at your feet; the rest slides into a deeper crack.
